title: Load-Shift Bonus Tiers, Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
**Rule.** The off-peak share of a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is the kWh of its off-peak energy lines divided by the kWh of all of its energy charge lines. At a share of 0.40 or more the high load-shift bonus of 10.00 USD is added to the sign-up credit; from 0.20 up to but not including 0.40 the mid load-shift bonus of 5.00 USD is added; below 0.20 nothing is added.

| Off-peak share | Load-shift bonus |
|---|---|
| 0.40 or more | 10.00 USD |
| 0.20 up to but not including 0.40 | 5.00 USD |
| below 0.20 | nothing |

**Reading the records.** Only a time-of-use agreement has off-peak energy lines; an agreement whose energy lines are all-hours lines has an off-peak share of 0 and adds nothing. An agreement with no kWh on its energy lines adds nothing.

**Worked shares (hypothetical).** 2,300 off-peak kWh of 4,900 total kWh is a share of about 0.469 and adds 10.00 USD; 1,000 of 5,000 is exactly 0.20 and adds 5.00 USD; 990 of 5,000 is 0.198 and adds nothing.
